estimand.basis: The player program documents a construction order, seven accounting constraints, a correlation requirement and a binding aggregation precedent for this track, and no target statistic, unit or denominator. A complete estimand exists on the TEAM thread (dist_margin_cover_v1, primary_metric margin_crps) and is deliberately not adopted: wrong thread, wrong universe (673 games vs 2,982 rows / 1,491 clusters), its own primary metric is disputed between design document and registry bytes, and it carries none of the player-side aggregation obligation.
